items.quote: This is a day of good news and we are keeping it to ourselves. If we wait until daylight, punishment will overtake us. Let’s go at once and report this to the royal palace.
items.contrast: The men intend to report the good news, not the valuables they took and hid.
items.reason: The alternative is plausible because the valuables are a prominent part of their actions, but they deliberately hide those items. In contrast, “this” in “report this” refers back to the good news they say they should not keep to themselves.
